text:
Athena-admin: Hi team — urgent. Trying to pull a compliance audit export for a subpoena (date range 2020-01-01 -> 2024-12-31) and getting a 403 from the /v1/audit/export endpoint since ~08:00 UTC yesterday. This is under our BAA; we need the bundle ASAP.

support-jordan: Sorry to hear that, we can help. Are you on Hosted or Private? Can you paste the exact curl you used + any request_id/correlation id from the error?

Athena-admin: Hosted (redwood.com account). Here's the curl we ran: 
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer xoxr-ATH-REDACT" "https://api.redwood.com/v1/audit/export?start=2020-01-01&end=2024-12-31&format=zip"
```
Error body: `{"error":"forbidden","code":403,"message":"Export blocked: key_policy mismatch (HSM_EXPORT_DENIED)"}`. Correlation header: `x-rw-req: 01F8X7ZQ9J3`. We also had a scheduled KMS rotation yesterday (they told us it would be automatic).

support-jordan: Thanks — tagging eng/sre and security. @eng-sre-lin can you take a look? Also @security-elaine FYI re: BAA/subpoena.

inc-bot: KMS rotation completed for alias rw/athena-prod-key at 2024-11-13T07:55:12Z (rotation-id: rot-20241113-5a).

eng-sre-lin: Looking. Can you confirm the org id and whether any custom HSM key policy was applied? Also paste the full response headers if you have them.

Athena-admin: Org ID athena-clinic-001. Full response headers: 
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json
Date: Wed, 13 Nov 2024 08:03:41 GMT
x-rw-req: 01F8X7ZQ9J3
WWW-Authenticate: HSM key policy mismatch
```
We didn't change policies ourselves. We do use customer-managed HSM via your Private offering earlier this year but this export was from Hosted (we have dedicated key alias linked to account).

security-elaine: Understood. Please confirm whether the export will include PHI (yes/no) and the legal point of contact for the subpoena. We'll need to assemble an attestation bundle and HSM key custody logs once export completes.

Athena-admin: Yes, contains PHI. Legal contact: legal@athena-clinic.example. We need the entailed logs + KMS/HSM attestation for court.

eng-sre-lin: Reproducing locally against your org id. I can see the export job is being blocked at HSM authorization: the new rotation alias has a stricter key policy that disallows EXPORT operations by the service principal used by the audit-export job. Error from internal logs: `HSM_EXPORT_ERR: policy_reject - caller=svc-audit-export principal=p-audit-01`.

support-jordan: Ok — root cause appears to be the rotation creating a policy mismatch. Two paths: 1) temporary manual export via an ops path (requires signed approval from your legal; will produce a time-limited S3 bundle) or 2) update key policy to allow the audit-export principal and re-run automated job. Which do you prefer for speed?

Athena-admin: We need this in 24 hours. Manual ops export + signed attestation is fine. Please also confirm we keep the same 7-year retention on your side (per BAA).

billing-maya: Confirming retention: athena-clinic-001 is on the healthcare retention package (7yr). We'll include billing confirmation in the package.

security-elaine: For the attestation we'll need: export checksum, rotation-id, HSM audit ledger slice for rotation window, and the key policy diff. Please email legal@athena-clinic.example a checklist and a secure upload link. I'll need the subpoena safe number too.

Athena-admin: Subpoena ref: SC-2024-9876. Legal is on the thread: legal@athena-clinic.example.

eng-sre-lin: Repro steps I ran: 
1) call export endpoint with org header `X-Org: athena-clinic-001`
2) service hits KMS alias `rw/athena-prod-key` which points to rotation-id rot-20241113-5a
3) HSM rejects EXPORT op -> 403 returned.

Snippet of the failing internal call: 
```
Request: POST /internal/hsm/export 
payload: {"key_alias":"rw/athena-prod-key","operation":"EXPORT_AUDIT_BUNDLE","job_id":"job-8721"}
Response: {"status":"denied","reason":"policy_reject","policy_rule":"no_export_after_rotation"}
```

support-jordan: For the manual path I'll need: (a) signed approval from an authorized legal signatory (PDF), (b) confirmation of recipient S3 bucket and ephemeral creds method, (c) preferred earliest delivery window. Can you attach the signed approval here or via secure upload?

Athena-admin: Uploading signed approval now via your secure form. Link: https://secure.redwood.com/forms/attest/athena-9876 (uploaded by legal).

inc-bot: Support ticket RW-SUP-4589 created and linked to thread. Priority: P0.

eng-sre-lin: Doing the manual export now. Creating a time-limited bundle and will place on a restricted S3 path. ETA ~2h.

Athena-admin: Thank you. One more ask — can you include a CSV of records with redaction map? Court requested the message IDs and timestamps; we can handle redaction after export.

eng-sre-lin: We'll include a metadata CSV (ids + timestamps + actor_ids) and a SHA256 checksum. We'll also attach the HSM audit ledger slice as PDF per security's checklist.

support-jordan: Quick note re: longer-term fix — if you want we can revert key policy to allow export principal after legal sign-off, or we can add an exception which still requires an approval flow. Security will advise on safest route.

security-elaine: My recommendation: don't relax key policy broadly. Add a temporary scoped policy binding for `svc-audit-export` that auto-expires and record approval events. We'll provide policy diff and the approval timeline.

eng-sre-lin: Manual export complete. Generated bundle: `s3://redwood-secure-exports/athena/SC-2024-9876/audit-export-20241113.zip` (signed, 48h expiry). Link (signed): https://redwood-secure.s3.redwood/athena/SC-2024-9876/audit-export-20241113.zip?X-Amz-SignedHeaders=...

support-jordan: Pushed package to your legal contact via secure deliver. Also added a support package with logs and the rotation policy diff: `support_export_01F8X7ZQ9J3.zip`.

Athena-admin: Downloaded and validating. Quick check — checksum matches, we can see the metadata CSV. Thank you.

billing-maya: Billing confirmation attached to the package. No charge for the manual export (waived) — we'll log as compliance assist.

security-elaine: We'll prepare the attestation doc and HSM ledger snippet. Expect a signed attestation by EOD.

Athena-admin: Appreciate it. Can you also confirm what caused the rotation to trigger the restrictive policy? We didn't request policy changes.

eng-sre-lin: Root cause: rotation job for alias rw/athena-prod-key included an updated policy template pushed by an automated onboarding script (internal bug). That template mistakenly set `no_export_after_rotation=true`. We're removing that template and adding the scoped exception process.

security-elaine: Follow-up action items: (1) security will provide policy diff and recommended exception pattern, (2) eng will patch rotation job to not overwrite custom policies, (3) support will document the ad-hoc manual export process for BAA customers.

Athena-admin: OK — please confirm via email once all items are done. Legal will need the attestation and an admin-signed cover letter.

support-jordan: Will do. Scheduling a quick 30min call to walk legal through artifacts — proposed time: today 17:00 UTC. If that works we'll send calendar invite.

Athena-admin: 17:00 UTC works for us. Thanks everyone.

inc-bot: Calendar invite created: RW-SUP-4589 / Athena subpoena call 2024-11-13 17:00 UTC.

eng-sre-lin: Marking RW tickets for follow-up. Will update once rotation-job fix is merged. :white_check_mark: 

security-elaine: Attestation will be in the package by EOD.

Athena-admin: Closing loop here — legal confirmed they received everything and verified checksums. We'll leave the thread open until attestation is in writing.

support-jordan: Thanks — leaving notes on the ticket and will post final attestation once available.

security-elaine: Attestation uploaded: https://secure.redwood.com/attestations/athena/SC-2024-9876-attestation.pdf.

Athena-admin: Got it — legal confirms attestation signed. Thread resolved from our side. Thank you all. :bow:
